prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a museum-quality 9:16 industrial futurist concept poster using the authorized adult identity reference. Show one realistic adult man in a long black technical coat, dark tailored trousers, and black boots walking alone toward the upper right across a metallic launch platform, body slightly leaning into resistance with a calm determined expression. Build enormous graphite MUSK letters into the physical architecture behind him, with scale contrast and realistic occlusion between letters, figure, and ground plane. Use a warm off-white paper background, charcoal industrial structures, subtle haze, strong negative space, subtle paper grain, and one precise hot-orange rocket trajectory slash cutting upward through the composition. Add optional small text FORWARD IS THE ONLY DIRECTION. Do not imitate Elon Musk or any public figure, and do not add logos or clutter.
